info.name: forgetrigger-scm-event-listener-auto-trigger-engine Postman Collection
info.description:
The automated ignition system for the ForgeSphere platform. 
Listens for incoming webhooks from Git SCMs (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), 
validates their cryptographic signatures, and translates commit events 
into Enhancement Pipeline executions. 
Also manages "subscriptions" to define which branches/repositories 
get automatically enhanced on specific events (push, pull_request, tag).


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

request.description:
Ingest GitHub webhook payloads

Responses:
- 202: Webhook accepted. Enhancement pipeline will be triggered if subscribed.
- 401: Invalid signature or missing authentication header.
- 400: Invalid payload, missing required fields, or unsupported event type.
- 500: Unexpected error while processing webhook or interacting with downstream services.
